description: Published robustness prompts for the eljazari.ai pipeline: possible, impossible, unsupported-by-simulation and ambiguous requests in Arabic and English. Categories state what a correct outcome is; they are fixed before any run so results cannot be scored after the fact. v2 keeps every v1 prompt unchanged and re-categorises two: hexacopters and octocopters now have flight models (docs/FLIGHT_MODEL_SITL.md), so v1's 'unsupported' definition no longer held. Two prompts for topologies that are still refused keep that category measured.

categories.supported: A flat X quad-, hexa- or octocopter request that a documented catalog combination (a published motor, propeller and voltage test) can fly within the flight-model and safety limits. Correct outcome: the deterministic simulation acceptance gate passes, including its comparison of the flight with the approved code's mission.
categories.impossible: A request that no documented catalog combination or safety limit allows. Correct outcome: the run stops at an explicit gate (prompt, design, components, model, safety or simulation block) instead of flying a silently weakened aircraft or mission.
categories.unsupported: A physically plausible request for a topology this release does not simulate (tricopters, fixed wings). Correct outcome: the run stops at an explicit gate; flying a multirotor instead is a silent requirement change.
categories.ambiguous: A request with no stated mission or payload. There is no single correct outcome; the benchmark reports what the pipeline did and whether it ended at a deterministic decision.

cases.prompt: A small quadcopter carrying a 150 g camera. Take off, hover at 10 m for 20 seconds, then land.
A quadcopter for roof inspection carrying a 300 g sensor. Fly a 20 m square at 15 m altitude, then return and land.
A lightweight quadcopter with a 100 g payload. Fly to a point 30 m north at 12 m altitude, then come back and land.
طائرة رباعية صغيرة تحمل كاميرا وزنها 200 غرام، تقلع وتحوم على ارتفاع 10 أمتار لمدة 20 ثانية ثم تهبط.
طائرة رباعية لمراقبة مزرعة تحمل حساساً وزنه 250 غرام، تطير في مسار مربع طول ضلعه 25 متراً على ارتفاع 15 متراً ثم تعود وتهبط.
درون رباعي خفيف يحمل 120 غرام، يطير إلى نقطة تبعد 30 متراً شمالاً على ارتفاع 12 متراً ثم يعود ويهبط.
A quadcopter weighing 250 g in total that carries a 20 kg payload and hovers for 2 hours.
A quadcopter carrying a 2 kg camera that hovers for 5 hours on a single battery.
طائرة رباعية تحمل 50 كيلوغراماً وتطير لمدة 4 ساعات دون توقف.
طائرة رباعية تحمل كاميرا 200 غرام وتصعد إلى ارتفاع 3000 متر ثم تهبط.
A hexacopter for crop spraying with a 3 kg tank. Fly a 20 m square at 5 m altitude and land.
cases.change_from_v1: v1: unsupported. No documented combination carries a 3 kg payload on a hexacopter: the catalog's only hexa frame (Tarot 680 Pro, 347 mm arms) keeps adjacent rotors 0.347 m apart, so propellers stay under 13.7 inches. Every combination the selector finds feasible for 3 kg is unsourced, which SITL refuses (selector, 2026-09-29: 64 feasible at 6S, 0 sourced; at 4S none reaches the 5 min endurance minimum).

cases.prompt: طائرة ثمانية المحركات تحمل كاميرا سينمائية وزنها 2 كيلوغرام، تحوم على ارتفاع 10 أمتار ثم تهبط.
cases.change_from_v1: v1: unsupported. A documented octocopter carries 2 kg (selector, 2026-09-29: 37 sourced combinations at 6S, best MN4014 KV400 + P15x5, thrust-to-weight 2.80; 4 at 4S).

cases.prompt: A fixed-wing survey plane carrying a 200 g camera. Fly a 100 m square at 30 m altitude and land.
cases.change_from_v1: new in v2: fixed wings have no flight model
